checks.evidence: Dialogue establishes family relationships and the morning situation before emotional stakes are introduced.
Cut from breakfast scene to the hallway is motivated by story progression and dialogue continuation.
Character designs, collars, and set consistency are maintained across scenes.
Voice ownership is clearly matched to the correct characters based on dialogue and framing.
Scene length allows adequate time for dialogue delivery and emotional weight without lingering unnecessarily.
Dog movements remain natural and within safe production constraints.
Scratch dialogue and ambient sound match the animatic requirements.
Viewers easily understand the backstory regarding Sebastian and the kennel fire.
The discovery of fresh fur directly motivates the ensuing debate about Sebastian's survival.
Characters react appropriately to revelations about being out late and smelling like food.
The final reveal of the lookalike dog pays off the mystery established by the scent discovery.
Plot points unfold at a steady, comprehensible rate fitting a mystery animatic.
